description: This file defines a class 'ThreadLocalStorage' that manages a thread-local cache of PDF documents, providing methods to add, remove, retrieve, and clean up document references based on file paths.

classes.name: ThreadLocalStorage
classes.description: Provides a thread-local cache for large PDF objects, managing documents through path-based keys and internal handles.

methods.name: AddDocument
methods.description: Adds a PDF document to the cache with its associated path.

methods.name: RemoveDocument
methods.description: Removes a document from the cache based on its path.

methods.name: GetDocument
methods.description: Retrieves a PDF document from the cache, loading and caching it if not already present.

methods.name: Documents
methods.description: Returns all currently cached live PDF documents.

methods.name: DetachDocument
methods.description: Removes references to a document handle from the cache and cleans up dead references.
